edges.reason: msg.sender is the implicit from address of transfer().
transfer() delegates all logic to _transfer().
transferFrom() calls _transfer() before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom() updates allowance via _approve().
msg.sender is used as spender when deducting allowance.
approve() writes the allowance through _approve().
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve().
_approve() writes _allowances[owner][spender].
from parameter feeds zero-address checks and tax logic in _transfer.
to parameter feeds checks, cooldown and buy detection in _transfer.
amount parameter drives tax computation and max-tx check.
_transfer() calls _isBuy() to classify the transfer.
_isBuy() compares the sender against uniswapV2Pair.
_transfer() records the first-buy timestamp in _buyMap when buying.
_transfer() reads and writes the cooldown timestamp for the recipient.
_transfer() sets _feeAddr1 before computing values.
_transfer() sets _feeAddr2 (8 or 65) before computing values.
_transfer() checks fee-exclusion status of participants.
_transfer() requires both parties not to be flagged in bots.
_transfer() enforces _maxTxAmount for cooldown buyers.
_transfer() compares addresses against uniswapV2Pair.
_transfer() checks inSwap to avoid recursive swapping.
_transfer() checks swapEnabled before auto-swapping.
_transfer() gates cooldown logic on cooldownEnabled.
_transfer() stores the contract token balance before swapping.
The contract token balance is passed to swapTokensForEth, an external-call routine invoked before balances are updated.
_transfer() performs the external swapTokensForEth call before _tokenTransfer updates state, enabling reentrancy.
The contract ETH balance (attacker-influenced during reentrancy) is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
_transfer() pushes ETH out via sendETHToFee before refunding/internal accounting completes.
swapTokensForEth() approves the router via _approve().
swapTokensForEth() reads and calls uniswapV2Router.
swapTokensForEth() calls the external router swap function.
tokenAmount parameter sets the swap input amount.
tokenAmount flows straight into the external swap call.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline parameter.
sendETHToFee() performs native ETH transfers to external wallets.
_feeAddrWallet1 receives half of the transferred ETH.
_feeAddrWallet2 receives half of the transferred ETH.
amount parameter is split between the two fee wallets.
manualswap() reads the contract balance via balanceOf().
manualswap() triggers the external swap routine without state guard beyond the fee-wallet check.
manualswap() authorizes the caller against _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the required caller of manualswap().
manualsend() pushes all contract ETH out through sendETHToFee() to external wallets.
manualsend() authorizes the caller against _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the required caller of manualsend().
openTrading() stores and uses the router instance.
openTrading() calls the factory createPair routine.
openTrading() assigns the returned pair to uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading() sends the contract's ETH balance to an external addLiquidityETH call.
onlyOwner modifiers gate openTrading().
onlyOwner modifiers gate setBots().
onlyOwner modifiers gate setMaxTx().
onlyOwner modifiers gate setCooldownEnabled().
onlyOwner modifiers gate renounceOwnership().
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() with _owner.
_owner is the trusted value compared inside onlyOwner.
setBots() writes attacker-supplied addresses into the bots blacklist.
setMaxTx() overwrites _maxTxAmount.
setCooldownEnabled() toggles cooldownEnabled.
_transfer() finishes by calling _tokenTransfer().
_tokenTransfer() routes to _transferStandard().
_transferStandard() computes amounts via _getValues().
tAmount parameter is the amount processed by _transferStandard.
_transferStandard() subtracts/adds _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_transferStandard() credits the team portion via _takeTeam().
_transferStandard() applies the fee via _reflectFee().
_getValues() derives token values through _getTValues().
_getValues() derives reflection values through _getRValues().
_getValues() fetches the current rate.
Multiplication/division derived amounts are returned to _transferStandard for balance accounting.
_getTValues() multiplies the amount by _feeAddr1 and divides by 100.
_getTValues() multiplies the amount by _feeAddr2 and divides by 100.
_getRValues() scales fee amounts by the reflection rate derived from _rTotal.
_takeTeam() fetches the current rate.
tTeam parameter is converted to reflection team amount.
_takeTeam() multiplies tTeam by the rate and adds it to the contract's _rOwned.
_reflectFee() subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee() adds the token fee to _tFeeTotal.
balanceOf() converts reflections into tokens via tokenFromReflection().
balanceOf() reads the reflection balance of the account.
tokenFromReflection() obtains the rate via _getRate().
tokenFromReflection() bounds the amount against _rTotal and divides by the rate.
_getRate() reads supplies from _getCurrentSupply().
_getRate() divides the reflection supply by the token supply.
_getCurrentSupply() reads _rTotal as rSupply.
_getCurrentSupply() reads _tTotal as tSupply.
block.timestamp decides which tax bracket and cooldown branch _transfer takes.
block.timestamp is stored in _buyMap on first buy.
block.timestamp is written into and compared with cooldown.
_msgSender() supplies the from address when transfer() is used.
constructor credits _msgSender() with the entire reflection supply.
constructor assigns _rTotal to _rOwned of the deployer.
constructor marks owner, contract and fee wallets as fee-excluded.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter used only at the entry of _transfer for address checks and tax classification; collapses into the core transfer function.
Parameter used only inside _transfer for buy detection and cooldown; collapses into the core transfer function.
Parameter consumed by the max-tx and tax computations inside _transfer; collapses into the core transfer function.
Parameter that is only forwarded into the router call inside swapTokensForEth; collapses into the core swap function.
Parameter split between the two fee wallets inside sendETHToFee; collapses into the core distribution function.
Local computed inside _transfer and immediately used as the swap input; collapses into the core transfer function.
Local computed inside _transfer and passed directly to sendETHToFee; collapses into the core ETH distribution function.
Parameter that drives reflection math inside _transferStandard; collapses into the core settlement function.
Parameter converted into a reflection team amount inside _takeTeam; collapses into the core team-fee function.
